summary: This standard covers companies that develop, manufacture and market brand-name and generic medicines. Its disclosure topics include clinical trial safety, access to medicines, pricing, drug safety, counterfeit drugs, ethical marketing, talent retention, supply chain management and business ethics.

questions.text: How does your organisation ensure quality and patient safety during clinical trials, by region?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe, region by region, the management processes, oversight and controls used to protect clinical trial participants and maintain trial quality.

questions.text: How many inspections related to clinical trial management and pharmacovigilance resulted in (1) voluntary remediation by your organisation or (2) regulatory or administrative actions against it?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of inspections for each of (1) and (2) separately, for the reporting period.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with clinical trials in developing countries?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: What actions and initiatives does your organisation have to promote access to health care products for priority diseases and in priority countries as defined by the Access to Medicine Index?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the actions and initiatives, the priority diseases and countries they target, and any outcomes achieved.

questions.text: Which of your products are on the WHO List of Prequalified Medicinal Products under its Prequalification of Medicines Programme (PQP)?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · List the products included on the WHO prequalification list; state if none apply.

questions.text: What was the percentage change in (1) the weighted average list price and (2) the weighted average net price across your product portfolio compared with the previous reporting period?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report both percentage changes separately, (1) list price and (2) net price, for the whole portfolio versus the previous period.

questions.text: What was the percentage change in (1) the list price and (2) the net price of the product with the largest price increase compared with the previous reporting period?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Identify the product and report both percentage changes, (1) list price and (2) net price, versus the previous period.

questions.text: Which of your products are listed in public medical product safety or adverse event alert databases?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Identify the products listed, the database concerned, and the actions taken in response; state if none.

questions.text: How many fatalities were associated with your products?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of fatalities associated with your products in the reporting period.

questions.text: How many product recalls did you issue, and how many units were recalled in total?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report (1) the number of recalls issued and (2) the total units recalled during the reporting period.

questions.text: What total amount of product, in metric tonnes, did you accept for take-back, reuse or disposal?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report the total weight of product accepted for take-back, reuse or disposal during the reporting period.

questions.text: How many enforcement actions were taken against your organisation for violations of good manufacturing practices (GMP) or equivalent standards, by type?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of enforcement actions and break it down by type (for example warning letters, fines, product holds, suspensions).

questions.text: What methods and technologies do you use to maintain traceability of products throughout the supply chain and prevent counterfeiting?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the traceability systems, serialisation or authentication technologies, and partner controls used along the supply chain.

questions.text: What is your process for alerting customers and business partners to potential or known risks associated with counterfeit products?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how risks are identified, who is notified, through which channels and how quickly.

questions.text: How many actions did you take that led to raids, seizures, arrests or the filing of criminal charges related to counterfeit products?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of such actions in the reporting period.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with false marketing claims?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: What code of ethics governs the promotion of off-label use of your products?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the code of ethics or policies, what they prohibit or permit, and how compliance is monitored.

questions.text: What efforts do you make to recruit and retain scientists and research and development staff?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe recruitment and retention initiatives, such as training, career paths, compensation and working conditions, aimed at scientific and R&D staff.

questions.text: What are your (1) voluntary and (2) involuntary employee turnover rates for (a) executives/senior managers, (b) mid-level managers, (c) professionals and (d) all others?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report percentage turnover rates for each of the four employee categories, separately for voluntary and involuntary turnover.

questions.text: What percentage of (1) your own facilities and (2) your Tier I suppliers' facilities participate in the Rx-360 International Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Consortium audit programme or an equivalent third-party audit programme?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report both percentages separately and name the audit programme used if it is not Rx-360.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with corruption and bribery?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: What code of ethics governs your interactions with health care professionals?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the code of ethics or policies covering interactions such as gifts, payments, sponsorship and speaker fees, and how compliance is monitored.

questions.text: How many patients were treated with your products?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of patients treated in the reporting period and state how the figure was estimated.

questions.text: How many drugs do you have (1) in your portfolio and (2) in research and development (Phases 1-3)?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of drugs in the commercial portfolio and the number in R&D, Phases 1 to 3.
